$doc: §23.6 ST-3. No C-8 band row (R-8381, §23.6h): CE-8009's rung 1 (STATUS_AggBackend.md §5) bands 9 v 9 standard riflemen at 100 / 200 / 275 m; this duel is 30 v 10 slots at 300 m - another force ratio, and the range R-8009 excludes as the M4's exact reach - so no band of the ladder applies and none is invented. What is encoded: losses on both sides, suppression, and who breaks first. Slot health is 25 when whole (UnitSplits.SlotFullHealth); 'down' = Health < 0.5 (UnitSlotTable.DownBelow); 'broken' = Stress >= 0.75 (AggregateUnits.BrokenAt). A Red squad is 10 slots; measured (re-authored 2026-11-17, R-8344, after CE-8009's measured rifle rate and body zones): a Blue man is hit at 3.25 s but none goes down in 180 s; Red has 8 down at 11.25 s, all 10 at 14.25 s, four broken at 7.25 s; Blue never breaks.

expect.name: the fight reaches the Blue platoon (a man is hit)
the fight reaches the Red squad (most of it is down)
the weaker side (Red) breaks: four slots at the break level
the stronger side (Blue) has not broken when Red has
